instruction: A boxy vintage wind-up tin robot with a square head, antenna, dial chest, claw hands and a wind-up key on its back. Litho-printed painted tin with rivets, slight worn scratches, 1950s retro toy charm.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE vintage tin wind-up robot in a retro tin toy style. Litho-printed painted tin with rivets, slight worn scratches, 1950s retro toy charm. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
